records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The confirmation, the earlier transfer joined by rf:refersToAct without a date, the ground in exact wording, the nepos kinship and the brother kinship are supported. Actor identifications follow the packet's candidates; leaving Gottfried local is correct because the regest itself offers two alternatives. The marital relation stated in 'ihre beiden Ehemänner' is not recorded, and the restoration of the monastery with Premonstratensians from Arnstein is left out, which is acceptable as background.

findings.description: The regest states a marital relation between the margravines and Gottfried and Bonifaz ('ihre beiden Ehemänner'), which is in scope as kinship. No rv:Marriage factoid records it. The pairing of each margravine with one husband is not stated, so a pairwise marriage would be inference; a candidate could still record the stated relation with the exact word 'Ehemänner' in rf:qualifier, or the gap should have been reported.
findings.evidence_quote: die von den Markgräfinnen Beatrix und Mathilde von Tuszien für das Seelenheil ihre beiden Ehemänner Gottfried (des Bärtigen, Herzogs von Niederlothringen, oder: des Buckligen, Herzogs von Niederlothringen) und Bonifaz’ (von Canossa, Markgraf von Tuszien) übertragenen Güter
findings.proposed_correction: Add a rf:StateFactoid of type rv:Marriage with rf:qualifier "Ehemänner" and rv:Spouse references to Beatrix, Mathilde, Gottfried (local) and Bonifaz only if the model accepts an unpaired collective marriage statement; otherwise report it as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220518:confirmation
findings.description: Friedrich (Graf) and Propst Anselm act 'Auf Betreiben' (admonente), the duke 'auf Bitten'. Both are mapped to rv:Petitioner, which flattens the regest's distinction between instigation and petition. The vocabulary offers no instigator role.
findings.evidence_quote: Auf Betreiben Friedrichs (hier als „Graf“ bezeichnet), des nepos König Konrads III., sowie des Propstes Anselm (von Arnstein?)
findings.proposed_correction: Keep rv:Petitioner but add rf:qualifier "Auf Betreiben" to mark the different wording, or report the missing role as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-A000944
findings.description: The regest marks Anselm's attribution to Arnstein with a question mark, and the Latin 'preposito prefatę ęcclesię' may point to the provost of the recipient church. The identification with the register candidate is admissible because the candidate carries the same doubt, but it remains uncertain.
findings.proposed_correction: No change; flag the identification as uncertain for expert review.

model_gaps: No instigator role distinct from petitioner ('Auf Betreiben' versus 'auf Bitten').
No way to record a collective marital statement whose pairing of spouses the regest leaves open.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. Brother kinship, the two parenthood relations of Barbarossa, both marriages of the duke, the heir designation and the entrusting of care are supported, and the earlier acts carry no date. Konrad's parenthood to the duke rests on 'den noch kleinen Sohn' in the duke's provision, a reading the sentence supports. The regest's main statement, Konrad III's consent to Barbarossa taking the cross and the duke's anger, is not recorded; the vocabulary has no type for consent or a crusade vow.

findings.description: Konrad III's consent that Barbarossa take the cross is the act the regest is about. The candidate records only the background acts. The contract has no consent or vow type; forcing it into rv:Enactment or rv:Confirmation would misstate it, so the omission is defensible but should appear as a model gap.
findings.evidence_quote: weil dieser zugestimmt hat, dass sein Sohn Friedrich (Barbarossa)
findings.proposed_correction: Report the consent to the crusade vow as a model gap in the batch report.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220519:entrusting-care
findings.description: Entrusting the care of wife and young son is typed rv:Appointment with the content in rf:qualifier. Appointment covers 'Beauftragung mit einer Aufgabe', so the type is acceptable; an rv:Obligation state would equally fit. Agnes and Konrad as rv:Beneficiary is a reasonable reading of 'Obhut über'.
findings.evidence_quote: die Obhut über seine zweite Frau (Agnes) und den noch kleinen Sohn (Konrad, den späteren Pfalzgrafen bei Rhein) anvertraut hat

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220519:heir-designation
findings.description: Heir designation is typed rv:Enactment with an inheritance right labelled 'Erben seines Landes'. Acceptable given the vocabulary; the extractor's comment already names the gap.
findings.proposed_correction: No change; keep the model gap.

model_gaps: No act type for consent to another's act.
No act type for taking the cross (crusade vow).
No act type for designating an heir.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The single grant is complete: Friedrich as grantor, Otakar (III.) as recipient, identified with the matching candidate rather than Otakar (IV.), and the Bergregal as right. No date is asserted for the grant.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:24069:bergregal
findings.description: The Bergregal is typed with the group concept rv:UsageRights because the vocabulary has no mining right. Correct handling of the limit.
findings.proposed_correction: No change; report the missing mining-right concept.

model_gaps: No right type for mining rights (Bergregal).

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The request with the bishop as petitioner and the emperor as addressee is supported and does not assert any action by the emperor. The counts of Panizo carry a vague role, and the possession of the goods by the church of Bologna is not recorded although a register candidate exists.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220528:request
findings.description: The counts of Panizo are the party against whom action is requested and the alleged plunderers. rv:Participant hides that they are the opposing party; the vocabulary's rv:Respondent fits a party complained against better.
findings.evidence_quote: gegen die Grafen von Panizo vorzugehen, welche die Güter der Bologneser Kirche plündern
findings.proposed_correction: Use rv:Respondent for the counts of Panizo, or report the missing 'target of requested action' role.

findings.description: The regest states that the goods belong to the church of Bologna, and the packet carries the candidate RI004-002-B001067 (Bologna, Bistum, Kirche). The thing node is labelled with the phrase, but no rv:Possession factoid names the church as possessor, so the economic relation is lost.
findings.proposed_correction: Add a rf:StateFactoid of type rv:Possession with an rv:Possessor reference to urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-B001067:community (nameInSource "Bologneser Kirche") concerning urn:regesta:220528:goods.

model_gaps: No act type for plundering or spoliation as an alleged wrong; it survives only as rf:ground.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The earlier request and the assurance of help are supported and correctly joined. The second half of the regest, Friedrich's request to the bishop to receive and escort his chancellor Rainald von Dassel, is not recorded.

findings.description: Friedrich asks the bishop to receive his chancellor honourably and give him escort to Faenza. This is a request, an act type the contract defines, with the bishop as addressee and the chancellor as the person concerned; the chancellor's office is named in the same passage and the packet carries the matching candidate RI004-002-R000076. The travel to the Curia is out of scope, but the request itself is not travel and is half of the regest.
findings.evidence_quote: bittet ihn, seinen Kanzler (Rainald von Dassel), der in Reichsangelegenheiten an die Kurie reist, ehrwürdig zu empfangen und ihm bis Faenza das Geleit zu geben
findings.proposed_correction: Add an rf:ActFactoid of type rv:Request with rv:Petitioner Friedrich, rv:Addressee Bischof G(erhard) von Bologna (nameInSource "ihn") and rv:Beneficiary urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-R000076 (nameInSource "Rainald von Dassel"), optionally an rv:OfficeHolding state for 'seinen Kanzler'. Do not assert that reception or escort took place.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The communication to the pope and the oath demand are recorded and linked. The demand is stated only as the bishop's report (subjunctive 'habe'), and the conditional unwillingness to swear is attached as a condition to the communication rather than to a factoid of its own.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220530:report
findings.description: 'nicht ohne päpstliche Erlaubnis' qualifies the bishop's unwillingness to swear the oath, not the act of informing the pope. Attached to the Communication, the condition reads as a condition of the letter. The bishop's stated stance toward the oath has no factoid of its own.
findings.evidence_quote: den er nicht ohne päpstliche Erlaubnis schwören wolle
findings.proposed_correction: Move the condition to a separate factoid for the bishop's stated refusal, partOf the communication, or keep it on the communication with a comment and report the missing act type for an oath or its refusal as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220530:oath-demand
findings.description: The regest reports the demand only as the content of the bishop's message ('dass ... gefordert habe'). The oath-demand factoid stands as an independent act; only the rf:refersToAct from the report hints at its status. A reader of the demand factoid alone takes it as the regest's own statement.
findings.evidence_quote: teilt Papst A. (Hadrian IV.) mit, dass der Kaiser nach der beinahe vollständigen Unterwerfung Italiens von ihm einen Treueid gefordert habe
findings.proposed_correction: Link the demand to the communication with rf:partOf, or add a qualifier marking it as reported ('mit, dass'), and report the missing way to mark reported content.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220530:report
findings.description: The sender of the communication is given rv:Grantor, defined as one who transfers, confirms or determines. The vocabulary has no sender role. 'gefordert' is typed rv:Request, which weakens a demand.
findings.evidence_quote: Bischof G(erhard) von Bologna teilt Papst A. (Hadrian IV.) mit
findings.proposed_correction: No change within the contract; report the missing sender role and demand type.

model_gaps: No act type for an oath of fealty, its demand or its refusal.
No role for the sender of a communication.
No means to mark an act as reported content of another act.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The permission with the pope as grantor, the bishop as recipient and the reservation 'salva ecclesie ac pontificum reverentia' as rf:exception is supported; the oath is not asserted as sworn. The identification of 'Papst G. (recte: Hadrian IV.)' follows the regest's own correction and the packet candidate. The emperor's role is imprecise.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220531:permission
findings.description: The emperor is the one to whom the permitted oath would be sworn; he takes no part in the pope's permission. rv:Participant implies involvement in the act that the passage does not state.
findings.evidence_quote: dem Kaiser salva ecclesie ac pontificum reverentia den Treueid zu leisten
findings.proposed_correction: Use rv:Beneficiary for the emperor, or drop the reference and record him in a comment, since the permission concerns a prospective oath to him.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220531:permission
findings.description: rf:qualifier "erlaubt" only repeats the verb and qualifies nothing the type does not. The consultation 'nach Rücksprache mit den Kardinälen' is the qualifying detail and could stand as the qualifier; the cardinals as rv:Participant is acceptable.
findings.proposed_correction: Replace the qualifier with "nach Rücksprache mit den Kardinälen".

model_gaps: No act type for a permission; rv:Enactment is used.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The file is an abstention. The military part (coming with troops, support against enemies) is out of scope, but the letter and the announced intercession with the emperor are acts the contract can express, and the guidelines exclude only military movement, travel and hostage taking, not communications or assurances. The abstention is not justified.

findings.description: The regest reports a letter from Welf (VI.) to Guido (III.) Guerra announcing that he will intercede with the emperor for him. rv:Communication and rv:Assurance cover this, and the packet carries matching candidates W000272 and G001188. The abstention reason ('no kinship, economic or legal relation') applies the exception clause of the military exclusion to the whole regest.
findings.evidence_quote: Herzog Welf (VI.) teilt Guido (III.) Guerra, Graf von Tuszien, mit, dass er sich beim Kaiser für ihn einsetzen werde
findings.proposed_correction: Add an rv:Communication factoid (Welf sender, Guido rv:Addressee) and an rv:Assurance factoid partOf it with Welf as rv:Grantor, Guido as rv:Beneficiary and the emperor as rv:Addressee of the intercession, without asserting that the intercession took place. Leave the troop and support passage out as military.

model_gaps: No act type for intercession on another's behalf.

records.coverage_note: Read packet and candidate in full. The single privilege grant to the town of St. Gallen is supported, with the recipient as community IRI from the packet candidate. No content of the privilege is asserted, which is correct.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:220541:privilege-grant
findings.description: 'ein Privileg ausstellen' is typed rv:RightGrant. A privilege of unknown content may also be a confirmation or protection grant, so the specific type slightly exceeds the passage; rv:Grant would be the safer top concept.
findings.evidence_quote: Friedrich stellt der Stadt St. Gallen ein Privileg aus
findings.proposed_correction: Consider rv:Grant, or keep rv:RightGrant with a comment that the content is unknown.

model_gaps: No act type for issuing a privilege of unstated content.
